Name: Jaques and the Bean Pole
Author: NGoldberg
Description:
[size=5]Introduction
[/size]
Jacques and the Bean Pole adds a new location up in the clouds reached by a beanstalk, with an associated quest line that rewards a special modded item.

[size=5]Features
[/size]
[list]
[*]Adds a whole new area to the game, accessible through an in game quest.
[*]Adds new NPCs to fit into the new area, including dialogue.
[*]Adds a new pair of pants that will give the player bonuses when worn.
[/list]
[i]﻿This mod was created as a team project for a game modding class within The School of Interactive Games and Media (IGM)at Rochester Institute of Technology in Rochester NY. IGM provides an educational environment that supports and encourages creative and collaborative academic inquiry by both faculty and students. IGM’s programs,  coursework, research, and development efforts provide students with the knowledge and skills to pursue meaningful  and rewarding careers in media-centric, interactive software development, while simultaneously advancing the field and helping to provide a well-rounded educational experience.

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1011403142723813406/1050925056164892682/rit_igm_logo_black.jpg[/img]
[/i]
